verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a large integrations catalog of "hundreds of vendors", browsable from an integrations page and a Data Platform Directory, plus forwarding of data to downstream services. Per-destination forwarding rules (e.g. "Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present") and consent filters provide filtering. A community user confirms routing one event stream to many analytics providers. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of per-destination field/event mapping (only a 'transform data as it leaves' title), general event/attribute filtering beyond consent-based rules, and in-depth per-integration docs content.
